paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.60% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.87%) and Hang Seng weakest (+0.44%). Brent crude changed -2.48% to 90.27. Gold changed -0.72% to 4,084.8. Bitcoin changed -1.32% to 74,231.1484. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.864%, a relative move of +0.10%. Among the firms tracked, Invesco (+6.76%) and Carlyle (+6.57%) moved the most.
